profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Tower Research Capital
profile.summary: I am a recent graduate with proficiency in Python, Go, C++, Data Structures and Algorithms. My interest primarily lies in Backend Engineering, Distributed Systems and Cloud Computing. I have contributed to multiple open-source projects including Scrapy, GoCV, Darkroom, SciPy, FOSSASIA, Processing, and others.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I worked with the Ads and Promotions Platform team, responsible for Gojek's advertising system. In 6 months, I learned Elixir and worked on delivering multiple customer-facing products, and features.

I took the engineering responsibility for Category Ads - a new ad inventory type focused on allowing merchants to target GoFood customers searching for specific cuisines, speed of delivery, and restaurants ratings. Category Ads achieved the highest booked value and realization rate among all ad inventory types. Further, I learnt internal tools & infrastructure and used them to automate the invoice delivery for Category Ads.

I also worked with a senior engineer to deliver a new ad inventory type catered towards FMCG brands, providing them the option to run banners on the GoFood homepage. Following the delivery, 5000+ global and local brands on-boarded on it.

I used Open API spec to document the Ads System API, automating the generation of API clients (SDKs), stubs, and mocks for it in 50+ languages. I also built the instrumentation pipeline responsible for recording the metrics around the events (views/clicks) received by campaigns past their limit. I created a Grafana dashboard for the same.

positions.title: Research Intern (Robotics Innovations Lab)
positions.description:
I worked under Prof. Abhra Roy Chowdhury at the Robotics Innovations Lab (https://cpdm.iisc.ac.in/ril/) of the Indian Institute of Science. 

My work focused on the application of vision-based systems for object detection and object sorting in warehouses. I developed a deep learning based vision system for inventory tracking in warehouses beating the state-of-the-art for the same in the process. The outcome of the research was published at the 20th International Conference on Control, Automation, and Systems (ICCAS) 2020, Busan S. Korea (organized by ICROS and sponsored by IEEE ) where it won the Best Student Paper Finalist Award for being among the top 10 student papers at the conference.

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
Work Report: https://anubhavp28.github.io/gsoc19-final-report/

Working under Python Software Foundation, I implemented an interface for robots.txt parsers in Scrapy (an open-source python based web-scraping framework), allowing its 270k+ users to substitute a more spec compliant parser than the default one. I further implemented this interface on top of the most popular robots.txt parsers, allowing the majority of Scrapy users to make the switch without having to write a single line of code.

As a side project, I worked on developing a fully spec-compliant pure-Python robots.txt parser to replace the non-compliant standard parser built into Python.  I used a mix of heuristics and design to achieve 4x the performance of any open-source alternative. Since its initial release, the parser has gained popularity with over 3k+ Github projects depend on it now.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
During the internship, I worked to implement a shopping cart with support for multiple payment gateways and discounts on products, the ability to calculate the international shipping cost, and an elegant user interface, which resulted in savings of $3000 every year by replacing the third-party cart plugin.

I also worked on a service to lazily resize images on user request with Amazon S3 as a storage backend.

projects.title: GitStalk
projects.description:
• Gitstalk is a command line tool that provides activity log of a GitHub user. This
activity log is more detailed than the one present on the user’s GitHub profile
page. It uses GitHub REST API.

projects.title: Shortify
projects.description:
• Created a URL shortening micro-service built on top of Redis and Flask, utilised
Postgresql as a persistent store to mitigate data loss due to failures.
• Utilised docker to containerise the service and allow for easy deployment.
